semantic_spine.literal_event: Paramedics perform rhythmic chest compressions and airway resuscitation on an unconscious drowning swimmer until seawater is coughed up and breathing resumes.
semantic_spine.semantic_focus: The physical act of chest compressions restoring respiration to an unconscious swimmer.
semantic_spine.emotional_relation: Tense urgency transitioning into relief upon revival.
semantic_spine.memory_hook: Interlocked hands compressing seawater out of the chest leading directly to expelled water and parting lips.

metaphor.literal_anchor: paramedics administering resuscitation to an unconscious swimmer until breathing and consciousness return

special_device.reason: The push-in progression across four diagonal strips carries the rescue and revival sequence completely without geometric disruption.

page_design.eye_flow_summary: Initial wide shoreline directs gaze diagonally downward to the kneeling rescuers, tightens onto the manual sternum compressions, and resolves on the swimmer coughing clear seawater toward screen right.

panels.semantic_job: Establish the immediate beach environment and the spatial relation between the rescue team, medical gear, and the water's edge.
